slides.texte_overlay:
how to build more confidence
+ independence

1. learn to fix small things yourself

a button, a flat tyre, a bill.
every fix is proof you can handle it.

2. eat out alone once a month

the first five minutes are awkward.
then it's the best hour of your week.

3. don't wait to feel ready

this morning i learned that françoise sagan was 18 when her first novel came out, and it made her famous.
she didn't wait.

3. don't wait to feel ready

this morning, the Sophia app taught me that françoise sagan was 18 when her first novel came out, and it made her famous.
she didn't wait.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. know where your money goes

one notebook, every expense.
independence starts there.

5. have opinions you can explain

read two sides before you choose yours.
which one are you starting this week?
